title_en: Biku and the Stuck Rath Wheel

character.name: Biku
character.description: Small white stickman, round white head, expressive black eyes, thin black arms and legs, bright red cape; same design across shots.

story: During Puri Jagannath Rath Yatra, a chariot wheel stops. Biku sees people edging too close, calmly warns them to stay back, and alerts trained volunteers and the chariot team. The trained team inspects and resolves the issue while volunteers keep the area clear. The Rath moves again safely. Biku learns that courage means acting wisely and getting the right help.

scenes.beat: Establish the Rath Yatra procession and Biku's excitement
Biku watches the decorated Rath from a safe place
The chariot slows and its wheel stops
The crowd reacts; people begin edging too close
Biku recognises the risk and signals people to step back
Trained chariot team inspects the wheel
Volunteers confirm the area is clear
Biku's lesson: courage is wise action; Jai Jagannath ending

closing_line_or: ସାହସ ମାନେ ବିପଦରେ ଝାପ ଦେବା ନୁହେଁ। ସଠିକ୍ ସମୟରେ ସଠିକ୍ ସାହାଯ୍ୟ ଡାକିବା ହିଁ ସତ୍ୟ ସାହସ।
safety: Trained staff handle chariot or lost-child procedures
